subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin compatibility checks during current-process package updates and convergence evaluate against the installed target package version before the gateway restarts?
rationale: That source-of-truth choice is upgrade-sensitive: it fixes stale-host skips, but it intentionally lets the old updater process make plugin update/discovery decisions using the version that will run after restart.

options.title: Accept target-version handoff
options.body: Rebase and land if maintainers agree the installed target version is the correct compatibility source for post-core plugin work before restart.

options.title: Require broader upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for packaged Windows or Linux npm-global update proof that covers plugin discovery during post-core update and after gateway restart before merge.

options.title: Pause for wider version-resolution fix
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the broader Linux/systemd unknown-host startup reproduction solved in the same change instead of a follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept target-version handoff
recommendation.body: Rebase and land if maintainers agree the installed target version is the correct compatibility source for post-core plugin work before restart.
